intent: Increased body width and wheel track for improved stability.
rationale: The telemetry from the last race indicated that the robot struggled with stability, as evidenced by a high number of line loss events (5 out of 8). To improve stability and reduce line loss, I will increase the body width to 0.16m (from 0.14m) and adjust the wheel track to 0.15m (from 0.12m). This should provide a wider base and better balance, which I expect will lead to fewer line loss events in the next race.
